The '''Dark Temple pass''' was a valley west of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The edifice known as the [[Dark Temple]] stood at the western end of the valley, and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Outpost Warden]] blocked the eastern end of the valley and the road to [[Kaas City]].
